COMMAND_REVIVE: Revive and heal (yourself or a player)
COMMAND_CAR: Spawn a vehicle and sit in it
COMMAND_DV: Delete the vehicle you sit in or stand next to
COMMAND_COORDS: Show your position (also printed in F8)
COMMAND_P_COORDS: x y z, x, y, z or x y (onto the ground)
NOTIFY_BROUGHT: An admin brought you to them.
ERR_NOT_ALLOWED: You do not have permission for this.
ERR_NO_WAYPOINT: Set a waypoint on the map first.
ERR_PLAYER_ONLY: Only a player in the game can do this.
ERR_NO_WEATHER: No weather script runs (or it refused the value).
COMMAND_P_WEATHER: EXTRASUNNY, CLEAR, CLOUDS, RAIN, THUNDER, SNOW, XMAS...
COMMAND_BLACKOUT: Turn the city lights off (1) or on (0)
COMMAND_FREEZETIME: Stop the clock (1) or let it run (0)
ERR_DOWN: That player is down: use revive.
ERR_MODEL: No vehicle with that model name.
ERR_VEHICLE: The vehicle could not be created.
ERR_NO_VEHICLE: No vehicle in or next to you.
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How noclip moves and what the admin car comes with. The menu (F9) and noclip keys are set in ai-core's Keybinds tab.
ADMIN_C_NOCLIP_DESC: Speed levels while flying: the mouse wheel changes the level, a wheel click resets it, Shift, Alt and Ctrl multiply it while held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_SPEED: Speed level when noclip starts and after a wheel click.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_MAX: The mouse wheel stops at this level.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_STEP: Level change per mouse wheel notch; also the lowest level.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_FAST: Speed multiplier while Shift is held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_FASTER: Speed multiplier while Alt is held.
ADMIN_H_NOCLIP_SLOW: Speed multiplier while Ctrl is held (below 1 slows down).
ADMIN_C_ANNOUNCE_DESC: A notification every player sees. The style and time also apply to /announce and the quick menu (F9).
ADMIN_H_ANNOUNCE_KIND: Colour and icon of the notification.
ADMIN_C_CAR_DESC: What a vehicle spawned with /car or the admin menu comes with. The admin always sits in the driver seat with the keys.
ADMIN_H_CAR_MAXED: Engine, brakes, transmission, suspension and armour at their top level, turbo and xenons on.
ADMIN_H_CAR_ENGINE: The engine is already on when the admin sits in.
ERR_ITEM_FULL: It does not fit in that inventory
ERR_ITEM_NONE: The player has none of that item
ERR_INVENTORY: The inventory could not be opened
COMMAND_ITEMS: Open the item list and take items
COMMAND_GIVEKEY: Give the keys of the vehicle you sit in or stand next to
COMMAND_REMOVEITEM: Take an item from a player (no count: all of it)
ADMIN_TAB_MESSAGES_DESC: Send an announcement to everyone or a warning to one player. Every message is logged with the admin who sent it.
ADMIN_H_ANNOUNCE_SEND: Sends the message to everyone; the message box empties afterwards.
ADMIN_Q_ANNOUNCE_SEND: Every player sees this message now.
ADMIN_C_WARN_DESC: An admin warning for one online player: it stays on their screen until they confirm it. Also in the quick menu (F9) > Players.
ADMIN_H_WARN_PLAYER: Players online when the panel opened; reopen the panel for players who joined since.
ADMIN_P_WARN_PLAYER: Search a name or citizen id
ADMIN_H_WARN_REASON: What the player did wrong, up to 300 characters; the player reads it as written.
ADMIN_P_WARN_REASON: Driving on the sidewalk in the city
ADMIN_H_WARN_SEND: Sends the warning to the player; the form empties afterwards.
ADMIN_TAB_WORLD_DESC: Weather and time for everyone, through the weather script that runs. A change applies at once; the weather script may change the weather later on its own.
ADMIN_C_WEATHER_DESC: Shows what an admin set last (here, with /weather or in the quick menu).
ADMIN_H_WEATHER: Picking one sets it for everyone now.
ADMIN_C_TIME_DESC: Changing the hour or minute sets the clock for everyone; it keeps running unless it is stopped.
ADMIN_H_FREEZE: The time stays where it is until switched off.
NOTIFY_WARNING: You received a warning from an admin.
ERR_BAN_LENGTH: Pick how long the ban lasts.
ERR_GRADE: That rank does not exist (ranks start at 0).
ERR_AMOUNT: The amount must be a whole number up to 1,000,000,000.
ERR_PERMISSION: A permission is one word of letters, digits or _ (admin, mod, god).
COMMAND_SETJOB: Give a player a job and rank (unemployed takes every job away)
COMMAND_SETGANG: Give a player a gang and rank (none takes every gang away)
COMMAND_GIVEMONEY: Give a player money on an account
COMMAND_DVALL: Delete every vehicle nobody sits in
COMMAND_DVP: Delete every ped that is not a player
COMMAND_ADDPERMISSION: Put a player in a permission group until they leave (group.<permission>)
COMMAND_REMOVEPERMISSION: Take a player out of a permission group
COMMAND_CLOSESERVER: Close the server: players without admin rights are kicked and cannot join
NOTIFY_NO_GANG: You are not in a gang.
NOTIFY_PERMISSION_ADDED: {0} is in group.{1} until they leave.
NOTIFY_SERVER_CLOSED: The server is closed: only admins can join.
